import altair as alt

# URL-based data source; declare types explicitly.
url = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vega-datasets@v1/data/movies.json"
data = alt.UrlData(url, format="json")

# Shared predicates to drop nulls on the rating columns on every view.
# (Scatter adds the Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating null-filter as well.)
imdb_not_null = "datum.IMDB_Rating != null"
rt_not_null = "datum.Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating != null"

# Reusable brush that drives all three views.
brush = alt.selection_interval(name="brush")

# ----- View A: scatter (brush host) ---------------------------------------
# IMDB vs Rotten Tomatoes, colored by Major_Genre inside the brush,
# otherwise flat 'lightgray'.
scatter = (
    alt.Chart(data, title="IMDB vs Rotten Tomatoes")
    .mark_point()
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("IMDB_Rating:Q", title="IMDB Rating"),
        y=alt.Y("Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating:Q", title="Rotten Tomatoes Rating"),
        color=alt.Color(
            "Major_Genre:N",
            legend=alt.Legend(title="Major Genre (inside brush)"),
        ),
        tooltip=["Title:N", "Major_Genre:N", "IMDB_Rating:Q", "Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating:Q"],
    )
    .properties(width=600, height=400)
    .add_params(brush)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("IMDB_Rating:Q", title="IMDB Rating"),
        y=alt.Y("Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating:Q", title="Rotten Tomatoes Rating"),
        color=alt.condition(
            brush,
            alt.Color("Major_Genre:N", legend=alt.Legend(title="Major Genre (inside brush)")),
            alt.value("lightgray"),
        ),
        tooltip=["Title:N", "Major_Genre:N", "IMDB_Rating:Q", "Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating:Q"],
    )
    .properties(width=600, height=400)
)

# ----- View B: bar of top-8 most frequent Major_Genre values ----------------
# Rank genres globally, then keep the top 8 regardless of the brush.
genre_ranking = (
    alt.Chart(data)
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .transform_aggregate(count="count()", groupby=["Major_Genre"])
    .transform_window(rank="rank(count)", sort=[alt.SortField("count", order="descending")])
    .transform_filter("datum.rank <= 8")
)

bar = (
    alt.Chart(data, title="Movies by Major Genre (top 8)")
    .mark_bar()
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .transform_filter(brush)
    .transform_lookup("Major_Genre", from_=alt.LookupData(genre_ranking, "Major_Genre", ["rank"]))
    .transform_filter("datum.rank != null")
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("count():Q", title="Number of Movies"),
        y=alt.Y("Major_Genre:N", sort="-x", title="Major Genre"),
        color=alt.Color("Major_Genre:N", legend=None),
        tooltip=["Major_Genre:N", alt.Tooltip("count():Q", title="Movies")],
    )
    .properties(width=300, height=200)
)

# ----- View C: IMDB_Rating histogram ---------------------------------------
hist = (
    alt.Chart(data, title="IMDB Rating Distribution")
    .mark_bar()
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .transform_filter(brush)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("IMDB_Rating:Q", bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=20), title="IMDB Rating (binned)"),
        y=alt.Y("count():Q", title="Number of Movies"),
        tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("IMDB_Rating:Q", bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=20)), alt.Tooltip("count():Q")],
    )
    .properties(width=300, height=200)
)

# ----- Compose layout: scatter on top, bar and histogram side-by-side -----
dashboard = scatter & (bar | hist)

dashboard.save("/home/user/myproject/chart.html")
print("Saved dashboard to /home/user/myproject/chart.html")
PYEOF

import altair as alt
from vega_datasets import data

# ---- Data --------------------------------------------------------------
movies_url = data.movies.url        # URL-based source, declared explicitly
movies_data = alt.UrlData(movies_url)

# Null-row filters, applied to every view. (Scatter also filters rotten nulls.)
imdb_not_null = "datum.IMDB_Rating != null"
rt_not_null = "datum.Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating != null"

# ---- Shared 2D interval brush -------------------------------------------
brush = alt.selection_interval(name="brush")

# ---- View A: scatter (brush host) --------------------------------------
# IMDB rating (x) vs Rotten Tomatoes rating (y).  Points inside the brush
# are colored by Major_Genre; points outside are flat 'lightgray'.
scatter = (
    alt.Chart(movies_data, title="IMDB vs Rotten Tomatoes")
    .mark_point(filled=True, size=60, opacity=0.7)
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("IMDB_Rating:Q", title="IMDB Rating"),
        y=alt.Y("Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating:Q", title="Rotten Tomatoes Rating"),
        color=alt.when(brush).then(
            alt.Color(
                "Major_Genre:N",
                legend=alt.Legend(title="Major Genre (inside brush)"),
            )
        ).otherwise(alt.value("lightgray")),
        tooltip=[
            "Title:N",
            "Major_Genre:N",
            "IMDB_Rating:Q",
            "Rotten_Tomatoes_Rating:Q",
        ],
    )
    .properties(width=600, height=400)
    .add_params(brush)
)

# ---- View B: genre bar (top-8 most frequent genres) ---------------------
# Aggregate -> window-rank -> keep top 8, all done *after* applying the brush.
bar = (
    alt.Chart(movies_data, title="Movies by Major Genre (top 8)")
    .mark_bar()
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .transform_filter(brush)
    .transform_aggregate(count="count()", groupby=["Major_Genre"])
    .transform_window(
        rank="rank(count)",
        sort=[alt.SortField("count", order="descending")],
    )
    .transform_filter("datum.rank <= 8")
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("count:Q", title="Number of Movies"),
        y=alt.Y("Major_Genre:N", sort="-x", title="Major Genre"),
        color=alt.Color("Major_Genre:N", legend=None),
        tooltip=["Major_Genre:N", alt.Tooltip("count:Q", title="Movies")],
    )
    .properties(width=300, height=200)
)

# ---- View C: IMDB rating histogram -------------------------------------
hist = (
    alt.Chart(movies_data, title="IMDB Rating Distribution")
    .mark_bar()
    .transform_filter(imdb_not_null)
    .transform_filter(rt_not_null)
    .transform_filter(brush)
    .encode(
        x=alt.X(
            "IMDB_Rating:Q",
            bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=20),
            title="IMDB Rating (binned)",
        ),
        y=alt.Y("count():Q", title="Number of Movies"),
        tooltip=[
            alt.Tooltip("IMDB_Rating:Q", bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=20)),
            alt.Tooltip("count():Q"),
        ],
    )
    .properties(width=300, height=200)
)

# ---- Layout -------------------------------------------------------------
# View A on top; View B and View C side-by-side underneath.
dashboard = scatter & (bar | hist)

dashboard.save("/home/user/myproject/chart.html")
print("Saved dashboard to /home/user/myproject/chart.html")
